title: Telling a Story in Order
label: ch:ta-telling-a-story-in-order
canDo: I can tell a short story in order with mutalil, ataṉ piṟaku and kaṭaiciyil, join actions with vantu and pōy, read a connected story of about eighty words, and read the letter ஈ in īram.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 285: tell a story in order with first, after that, having done and in the end, and read and write ஈ.
